## What is this feature for?

The console groups settings affecting all accounts and separates platform administration from access to private maps.

:::caution
This page covers instance administration and is only available to administrators.
:::

## Before you start

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Where can I find it?** | User menu → Administration → General |
| **Access** | Administrator |

## Where can I find it?

Follow this path in the interface : **User menu → Administration → General**.


![Configure the instance — desktop screen](/docs/screenshots/admin-general-en-light.png)

*Configure the instance — desktop screen*

![Configure the instance — mobile screen](/docs/screenshots/admin-general-en-mobile.png)

*Configure the instance — mobile screen*

## How do I use it?

1. Open Administration; General is selected by default.
2. Change the required blocks.
3. Click Save to apply pending changes.

### Expected result

Configuration toggles are staged until saved.

## How does it work?

- Configuration toggles are staged until saved.
- Closing with unsaved changes opens a warning.
- Administration grants no implicit access to private content.

## Good to know

:::note
- Reserve this role for people operating the instance.
:::
